reader.reads: Each German place, both theses and each relation; all four places on the scan, including the two pages of III p349.

friedrich-schiller.ueber-das-pathetische.note: On p. 350 the second kind of suffering shows ‘seine Bestimmung dazu’ and the person as an ‘ästhetisch großer Gegenstand’; p. 351 says a person presents ‘die Würde der menschlichen Bestimmung durch seinen Zustand’. The thesis joins these statements into a relation between suffering and dignity which neither place itself states.

suffering:can-present-in-aesthetic-estim.note: P. 350 says the second kind of suffering shows the person's vocation to moral character; p. 351 says the person's condition presents the dignity of human vocation. The verb joining suffering to dignity is a reconstruction across the places, not stated by either place.

images.note: The enlarged line reads ‘erst als empfindendes Wesen bey uns legitimirt haben’.
The Latin quotation ends ‘corripiunt,’ on the page; the packet has ‘corripiunt.’ The enlarged line begins ‘Affekte sind ästhetischer aus der zweyten’.
The enlarged line reads ‘dem zweyten bloß als ein ästhetisch großer’ across the line break.

summary: Four conceptions stand on their places. The reconstruction and link combine statements made separately, and the Latin quotation's final mark differs from the packet.
